title: DNaseI and Flowcell Clearing for Long Read Yields and Multi-Sample Sequencing
author: John Tyson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7eqhjdw

steps.title: Prepare DNaseI digestion buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 200 µL Flowcell Buffer (FB) with 2 µL of 100 mM CaCl₂ and 2 µL DNase I (2 U/µL) to create the DNaseI flowcell digestion buffer.

steps.title: Add digestion buffer to flowcell
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL of the DNaseI digestion buffer into the flowcell through the Sample port and close the port.

steps.title: Incubate and monitor pores
steps.instruction: Incubate the flowcell for 20 minutes to 2 hours (depending on the sample) while watching the Single‑Pore : Strand numbers reported in MinKNOW.

steps.title: Flush flowcell with FB buffer
steps.instruction: Flush the flowcell by adding 400 µL of FB buffer through the Sample port.

steps.title: Add FB plus Tether
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of FB + Tether to the flowcell through the Sample port.

steps.title: Incubate for five minutes
steps.instruction: Close the Sample port and incubate the flowcell for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Open the Sample port and remove any trapped air.
Add a small volume of FB + Tether through the Sample port to prime the SpotON port.

steps.title: Start MinKNOW and monitor
steps.instruction: Launch MinKNOW software and continue monitoring Single‑Pore : Strand numbers.

steps.title: Remove air (first use)
steps.instruction: Open the Sample port and remove any air, as is normally done when first using a flowcell.

steps.title: Stop MinKNOW when pores drop
steps.instruction: When the strand pore count has dropped to the desired level, stop MinKNOW.

steps.title: Remove air before loading library
steps.instruction: Open the Sample port and remove any air.

steps.title: Load library onto SpotON
steps.instruction: Spot 75 µL of freshly prepared library (DNA + SQB + optional LLB) onto the SpotON port, then close the SpotON port followed by the Sample port.

steps.title: Start sequencing run
steps.instruction: Begin the sequencing run in MinKNOW.
